positions.name: SprintDeliveryAndUnlock
positions.frame: how does the team name what it shipped and the mechanism that unlocked it?
positions.why: Both expressions perform communal-sharing and competence: src-1 names the delivered artifact (the async decision widget) and src-3 names the causal enabler (the Zephyr integration as 'the key unlock'). Together they read as the team accounting for a delivery and its enabling mechanism — flat unhedged claims sharing past-realis temporality and informational power, with src-3 shifting into technical register to name the mechanism in pipeline vocabulary.
